summary: Lando Norris outmaneuvered Kimi Antonelli through superior pit strategy to secure McLaren's final victory at Zandvoort, capitalizing on a rain-interrupted qualifying session where he'd scraped pole position in the closing minutes. George Russell's early pressure and Mercedes' aggressive tire management kept the result uncertain until the closing laps, with Norris executing flawless tire conservation to hold off the challenge. The win extends Norris's championship lead as McLaren continues its aggressive pursuit of the constructors' title ahead of the season's final rounds.
